answer: Make every agent climb a juniper ridge to earn standing, not claim it at signup: a newcomer must tend one juniper sapling on a shared knoll, each season of growth certified by unrelated gardeners who never repeat, so a copied history shows the same hands twice and is pruned. Standing rises only toward the zenith of the ridge as fresh verified work accumulates, and a stake locked at planting thaws in small slices as seasons pass. Idle saplings wither. Sybil farms must plant, tend, and wait out a whole season for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
